site: iCIMS (Mutual of Enumclaw, hCaptcha); any portal whose layout retains CAPTCHA frames after page transition
class: A CAPTCHA wait continued polling after the form had already been submitted and the page navigated to the next step
symptom: On Mutual of Enumclaw (iCIMS), the applicant solved hCaptcha on the profile creation page and the site navigated to the candidate application form (/candidate?from=profilebuilder), but the agent sat waiting for an instruction because captcha_visible remained True due to persistent CAPTCHA assets in the layout.
root_cause: _wait_for_signal(for_captcha=True) only terminated when safety.captcha_visible(page) became False for 2 consecutive polls, without checking whether the page path had changed or password fields had disappeared.
why_tests_missed: CAPTCHA stop tests tested single pages where the widget vanished rather than multi-page navigation across form steps.
fix: In browser_automation._wait_for_signal, record the initial URL path and password field count; during the CAPTCHA wait, if the URL path changes or password inputs disappear, treat the page as moved on and return 'refresh' immediately.
prevention: A wait for a security gate must track page progression (URL and DOM form state), not only isolated third-party widget visibility.
